description: START HERE for any coin question. A short, decision-ready summary for 1–10 coins in one call: price, 1D and 4H trend (up/mixed/down with the reasons), nearest support and resistance with distance %, ATR (volatility, for stops), RSI, every Asrai signal (ALSAT, SuperALSAT, AlphaTrend, TD9) with its AGE in days, the last 14 days' key news, the crowd mood (what people post, mostly on X: % positive, posts in 24h, talk vs its normal week — when there is enough talk), and a one-line verdict. For the business and investors behind a coin use fundamentals. Use for: 'is X a buy', 'how does X look', 'compare X, Y, Z', 'key levels of X'. Then trade_plan for a concrete entry/stop/target.
name: coin_brief
